# Hyperion Vault - AI Fast Index & Token Optimizer (v6.30.0)
> Target: Laravel 13 Sanctum + SQLite/MySQL + Svelte 5 Runes on Windows Laragon / Hostinger Shared Hosting. Synchronized with PQTM enterprise production standard.

```yaml
version: "6.31.0" # SemVer 2.0.0 (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
system_type: "SPA + RESTful API"
backend: "Laravel 13 (PHP 8.3/8.4), Sanctum Session Auth, SQLite WAL / MySQL"
frontend: "Svelte 5 (Pure JS Runes: $state, $derived, $props), Tailwind CSS v4"
web_server: "Nginx Laragon (Zero-Config Universal Gateway: index.php + .htaccess Brotli/Gzip delivery)"
installer_updater: "install.php (Web / CLI wizard, safe in-place updater 'php install.php update', .installed lock & history log)"
domain: "http://hyperion-vault.test (aliases: localhost, 127.0.0.1)"
scale_profile: "Indexed for 9000+ records (B-Tree composite indexes + 1000 item safe limit ceiling)"
workers: "FastCGI 127.0.0.1:9003 & 9004 (PHP_FCGI_MAX_REQUESTS=0)"
session_driver: "file (NVMe SSD I/O, ZERO MySQL connection overhead + physical unlink GC)"
device_registry: "user_devices (Real-time active device tracking & granular revocation)"
rbac_engine: "Dynamic Role-Permission Matrix (backend/config/permissions.php + EnsurePermission)"
css_engine: "Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite: Rust LightningCSS engine, sub-ms build, 0 runtime)"
slo: "99.0% Uptime, Latency P99 < 150ms (Actual: ~65ms), MySQL conns <= 0.16 / 25"
security_profile: "Sanctum CSRF + HMAC-SHA256 JWT + Security Headers + POIN Defense + .installed Lock"
test_status: "PHPUnit: 18 passed (250 assertions, 100% green) | Static Build: 0 warning a11y (100% Green)"
design_spec: "doc/design.md (Universal Dual-Theme: Daylight & Dark Obsidian, 2-Font Plus Jakarta/Inter, WCAG AAA)"
feature_engine: "doc/prompt.feature.md (Track A Feature Synthesis & Track B Landing/Style Customization Engine)"
```

## 3. KONDISI PRASYARAT PASCA CLONE (PREREQUISITES CHECKLIST)
Sebelum instalasi dijalankan pada mesin baru, pastikan kondisi berikut terpenuhi:
1. **Git**: Terpasang di sistem (`git --version`).
2. **PHP 8.3 / 8.4 CLI & Ekstensi Aktif**:
   - `pdo_sqlite` & `sqlite3` aktif di `php.ini` (atau `pdo_mysql` jika menggunakan MySQL).
   - `curl`, `mbstring`, `openssl`, `fileinfo`, `json` aktif.
3. **Package Managers**:
   - Composer 2.x (`composer --version`).
   - Node.js versi 18+ (disarankan Node 20+) & npm (didukung universal lintas versi via `frontend/.npmrc`).
4. **Web Server & Hosts**:
   - Laragon Nginx berjalan pada port `80`.
   - Host mapping (`C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts`): `127.0.0.1 hyperion-vault.test`.
   - Direktori root repositori: `D:\laragon\www\hyperion-vault`.
5. **Port Jaringan Aktif**:
   - `80`: Nginx reverse-proxy universal gateway (`index.php`).
   - `9003` & `9004`: Dual worker FastCGI persisten (`$env:PHP_FCGI_MAX_REQUESTS="0"`).
   - `5173`: Vite frontend dev server (internal).

---

## 4. PROSES INSTALASI DETERMINISTIK PASCA CLONE (POST-CLONE SETUP)

### Jalur 1: CLI Otomatis (1-Langkah Mandiri - Rekomendasi AI & CI/CD)
```powershell
cd D:\laragon\www\hyperion-vault

# 1. Jalankan installer otomatis (otomatis menginstal Composer & npm jika belum ada)
php install.php install

# 2. Jalankan FastCGI ganda persisten & Vite dev server
$env:PHP_FCGI_MAX_REQUESTS = "0"
Start-Process -FilePath "D:\laragon\bin\php\8.3\php-cgi.exe" -ArgumentList "-b 127.0.0.1:9003" -WindowStyle Hidden
Start-Process -FilePath "D:\laragon\bin\php\8.3\php-cgi.exe" -ArgumentList "-b 127.0.0.1:9004" -WindowStyle Hidden
cd frontend && Start-Process -FilePath "cmd.exe" -ArgumentList "/c npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" -WindowStyle Hidden && cd ..
```

### Jalur 2: Wizard Peramban Web (Auto-Detect 1-Klik)
1. Buka peramban di `http://hyperion-vault.test/`.
2. Gateway `index.php` mendeteksi ketiadaan berkas `.installed` dan otomatis me-redirect ke `http://hyperion-vault.test/install.php`.
3. Klik **"Jalankan Instalasi Otomatis Sekarang"** (atau akses langsung `http://hyperion-vault.test/install.php?auto=1`).
4. Sistem otomatis mengonfigurasi `.env`, membangkitkan `APP_KEY`, inisialisasi basis data SQLite WAL, migrasi & seeding, serta membuat berkas lock `.installed`.

### Kredensial Default Sistem:
- **URL Aplikasi**: `http://hyperion-vault.test`
- **Administrator**: `admin@hyperion-vault.test` / `password123` (Roles: `['admin', 'manager']`)
- **Regular User**: `user@hyperion-vault.test` / `password123` (Role: `['user']`)

## 5. MEKANISME PEMBARUAN SISTEM (SAFE IN-PLACE UPDATER)
Jika terdapat pembaruan arsitektur atau kode dari GitHub (`git pull`):
```powershell
# Jalankan safe update in-place (Non-destructive: tidak menghapus data pengguna!)
php install.php update
```
- **Tindakan Otomatis:**
  1. Membersihkan cache aplikasi (`artisan optimize:clear`).
  2. Menjalankan migrasi pending secara aman (`artisan migrate --force` - **DILARANG** `migrate:fresh`).
  3. Mengompilasi ulang bundel SPA (`npm run build`).
  4. Mencatat riwayat versi & timestamp pada berkas `.installed`.
- **Akses Web Updater:** Akses `http://hyperion-vault.test/install.php` -> Klik tombol **"Perbarui Sistem Sekarang (Safe Update)"**.
- **Audit Endpoint API:** `GET /api/v1/admin/version` menampilkan status versi kode vs versi instalasi.

---

## 6. HAK AKSES & MATRIKS IZIN KUSTOM (CLIENT RBAC)
- Konfigurasi: [backend/config/permissions.php](file:///D:/laragon/www/hyperion-vault/backend/config/permissions.php).
- Model Helper: `$user->hasPermission('users.create')` / `$user->getPermissions()`. Role `admin` otomatis memiliki wildcard `['*']`.
- Backend Protection: `Route::middleware('permission:reports.export')->...` atau `Route::middleware('role:admin,manager')->...`
- Frontend Protection: Svelte 5 `$derived(authState.hasPermission('reports.export'))`.
- Menambah Role Klien: Cukup daftarkan di `config/permissions.php` tanpa perlu migrasi tabel!
- **Strictly Explicit Roles & Zero Consolidation:**
  - Seluruh peran disimpan dan diuji persis sesuai penugasan nyata. Multi-role assignment didukung secara native via array storage.
  - Zero role consolidation, zero aliases, zero runtime mutating conversion. Dilarang keras membuat `consolidation_map` atau `aliases`.

---

## 7. AI AGENT GOLDEN INVARIANTS (NEVER BREAK THESE)
1. **DO NOT change `SESSION_DRIVER` to `database`**: Hostinger Shared MySQL limits max simultaneous connections to 25. `SESSION_DRIVER=file` uses NVMe SSD disk I/O with 0 database connections. The `user_devices` table is an audit registry only.
2. **DO NOT use TypeScript in frontend**: Pure ES2024 JavaScript with Svelte 5 Runes (`$state`, `$derived`, `$props`).
3. **DO NOT alter Laragon Nginx vhost files**: Root `index.php` acts as zero-config universal gateway routing API, storage, and Vite dev server.
4. **DO NOT run Windows PHP-CGI without `PHP_FCGI_MAX_REQUESTS=0`**: Without it, php-cgi worker exits after request limit, causing 502 Bad Gateway.
5. **DO NOT scan physical session files on disk**: Stale/revoked sessions are purged atomically via `UserDevice::purgeStaleSessions()` using indexed `expires_at`.
6. **DO NOT remove `.installed` lockfile in production**: Prevents unauthorized reinstallation and database wiping.
7. **DO NOT run unbounded queries (`Model::all()`)**: Enforce safe limit ceilings (`limit(1000)`, max 5000) and composite index filters to protect against memory exhaustion DoS (>18MB) on 9000+ records.
8. **DO NOT run destructive `migrate:fresh` during updates**: Always use `php install.php update` which executes safe `migrate --force`.
9. **ALWAYS maintain SemVer 2.0.0 format (`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`)**: In `composer.json`, `package.json`, `install.php`, and all docs.
10. **BROWSER-ONLY INSTANT SEARCH**: `DataTable.svelte` and `MultiItemPicker.svelte` use `$derived.by()` to filter items in browser memory (< 0.1ms). Never send keystrokes to database API.
11. **SVELTE 5 REACTIVITY & NO REDUNDANT EFFECTS**: Use `$derived` for calculated state. Avoid `$effect` mutating the same state it reads to prevent circular reactivity loops.
12. **AUTO-REJECT SHIELD**: Guard unauthorized routes synchronously in `+layout.svelte` to prevent DOM paint leaks before redirection.
13. **SPA STATIC DEPLOYMENT (ZERO NODE ON HOSTINGER)**: Always build with `@sveltejs/adapter-static` (`fallback: 'index.html'`, `ssr = false`). On Hostinger Shared Hosting, Nginx/PHP serves `frontend/build/index.html` with zero Node.js server overhead.
14. **PASSWORD VISIBILITY TOGGLE (EYE ICON)**: All password inputs (`LoginForm.svelte`, user modals) must provide SVG eye toggle buttons with Svelte 5 `$state` and `aria-label`.
15. **STICK TO DESIGN TOKENS**: All UI additions must adopt palette `#090d16` / `#0f172a`, primary indigo `#4f46e5`, accent cyan `#06b6d4`, and 44px min touch targets as defined in `desain.md`.
16. **ZERO SILENT FAILURE & ERGONOMIC DENSITY**: Every interactive button must trigger reactive visual feedback (loading state, floating toast notification, or form feedback). For dense multi-assignment lists, maintain 12-14px crisp readability with WCAG AAA contrast, avoiding oversized UI elements that exceed standard 768p laptop viewports.
17. **ZERO ROLE CONSOLIDATION & STRICT RBAC MATRIX**: DILARANG KERAS membuat konsolidasi peran (`consolidation_map`, `aliases`, `normalizeRoles`, dan `expandRoleAliases`) di model `User`, `config/permissions.php`, route guard, atau frontend auth state. Seluruh peran wajib diakui dan disimpan secara mandiri dan presisi tanpa mutasi nama atau aliasing tersembunyi.
18. **STRICT ROLE CONFIGURATION & ZERO SESSION LEAKAGE (OWASP ASVS)**: Pengguna yang memuat peran yang tidak terdaftar di `config/permissions.php` DILARANG KERAS diberikan sesi, token JWT, ataupun akses login. Jika terdeteksi saat login (`AuthController`), request wajib ditolak seketika (HTTP 422), session di-invalidate, dan kuki dibersihkan. Jika terdeteksi pada sesi aktif (`CheckUserActive`), sesi wajib langsung diputus (HTTP 403), record di `user_devices` dihapus, dan berkas fisik sesi di disk NVMe di-unlink.
19. **ZERO ROLE ENUMERATION / ZERO INFORMATION DISCLOSURE**: Seluruh pesan kesalahan otentikasi, validasi, otorisasi controller, dan middleware DILARANG MEMBOCORKAN daftar nama peran kanonikal sistem (OWASP Top 10 A01:2021 Information Disclosure prevention). Gunakan pesan umum/generik yang santun dan aman (contoh: *"Akun Anda tidak memiliki peran yang valid. Silakan hubungi pengelola sistem."* atau *"Akses ditolak: Anda tidak memiliki wewenang untuk tindakan ini."*).
20. **CONTROLLED MODAL LIFECYCLE (SVELTE 5 RUNES)**: `Modal.svelte` must default to `show = true` to guarantee instant rendering inside conditional blocks `{#if showModal}<Modal>`.
21. **STICKY HEADER TABS MODAL CONTRACT**: Every multi-step/subtab modal dialog must place its tab navigation bar inside the sticky modal header (`headerTabs` snippet in `Modal.svelte`), preventing tab navigation from scrolling away when viewing long forms.
22. **BABY BOOMER & NON-TECH USER ACCESSIBILITY (ERGONOMICS)**: Form controls and modal views must maintain high visual affordance for older and non-tech users: 2px solid borders on inputs and tab cards, 44px min touch height (`text-base sm:text-sm px-3.5 py-3`), clear guidance callouts per step, explicit pill badges (`* Wajib Diisi` and `(Boleh Kosong)`), and reassuring bottom action buttons (`[✕ Batal / Tutup]`, `[← Kembali]`, `[Lanjut 👉]`, `[💾 Simpan Data]`).
23. **PHYSICAL SESSION UNLINK ON LOGOUT**: Logout and session revocation execute real-time physical unlink `@unlink(storage_path('framework/sessions/' . $sessionId))` on NVMe disk, purging orphaned session files to prevent session replay and PHP Object Injection risks.
24. **MANDATORY SYNCHRONOUS DOCUMENTATION UPDATE RULE (ZERO SILENT DRIFT)**: Every code modification (bugfix, refactor, schema change, UI style adjustment, or new feature) MUST atomically update corresponding documentation files (`doc/architecture.md`, `doc/prompt.feature.md`, `doc/features/`, `doc/design.md`, `doc/GEMINI.md`, and `doc/changes.md`) within the exact same turn before reporting completion. Silent code drift is strictly forbidden.
25. **FASTCGI DUAL WORKER RESILIENCY (PORT 9003/9004)**: Windows Laragon FastCGI runs dual persistent workers on ports 9003 and 9004 with `$env:PHP_FCGI_MAX_REQUESTS="0"`. Nginx round-robin upstream prevents 502 Bad Gateway during worker process restarts.
26. **PURE CSR & SPA ARCHITECTURE**: Root layout enforces `ssr = false`, `csr = true`, `prerender = false`, `trailingSlash = 'never'`. All UI transitions operate in-memory with zero full-page reload.
27. **CORE WEB VITALS TARGET 2026**: INP < 100ms via Svelte 5 runes, LCP < 1.2s via build-time Brotli/Gzip precompression, and CLS < 0.05 via defined layouts and skeleton loaders.

---

## 8. PETA ENDPOINT RESTFUL API
- `GET  /sanctum/csrf-cookie`: Inisialisasi token CSRF.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login`: Autentikasi, catat device di `user_devices`, terbitkan HttpOnly session & signed JWT dengan klaim roles dan permissions.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`: Terminasi sesi, hapus device record, bersihkan cookie domain.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/logout-other-devices`: Putus sesi perangkat lain milik user saat ini (+1 `token_version`).
- `GET  /api/v1/auth/me`: Data profil & multiple roles terotentikasi.
- `GET  /api/v1/admin/version`: Status versi sistem, versi terpasang, pembaruan tersedia, dan riwayat update.
- `GET  /api/v1/admin/users`: Daftar pengguna (`?search=`, `?status=`, `?limit=`).
- `POST /api/v1/admin/users`: Buat akun baru dengan multiple roles.
- `PUT  /api/v1/admin/users/{id}`: Edit data pengguna, role, dan password.
- `DELETE /api/v1/admin/users/{id}`: Hapus akun pengguna (proteksi akun sendiri).
- `POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/toggle-status`: Tangguhkan / aktifkan akun.
- `POST /api/v1/admin/users/{id}/revoke-sessions`: Cabut seluruh sesi user (+1 `token_version`).
- `GET  /api/v1/admin/sessions`: Audit perangkat aktif real-time (IP, User-Agent, Device, OS, Expiry).
- `POST /api/v1/admin/sessions/{id}/revoke`: Cabut sesi 1 perangkat spesifik.
- `POST /api/v1/admin/sessions/user/{id}/revoke`: Cabut seluruh sesi user target.
- `POST /api/v1/admin/sessions/revoke-all`: Global kill-switch darurat.
- `POST /api/v1/admin/sessions/cleanup`: Purge SQL atomik sesi kadaluarsa / stale.
